title: Tizbin
features: Easy registration: name, phone number and avatar pick, optional referral code
User profile with total points and referral link
Daily competition: 15 challenges, 90-second total active-play limit, one official scored attempt per day
Five simple visual games with reusable mechanics: find the different picture, which picture disappeared, count identical objects, same or different, match identical pictures
Automatic scoring: 100 points per correct answer plus a speed bonus from remaining seconds, max 1,590
Daily leaderboard and monthly leaderboard (best 15 daily scores), ranked by accuracy then speed
Social sharing of the result and referral invite link
Basic admin view to review users, flagged scores and the manual prize record
Server-side score validation and basic abuse prevention (simulated locally)
Low data usage and offline-tolerant play (assets bundled, result queued until online)

bottomTabBar.note: Right-to-left: Home is the RIGHTMOST tab, then Ranks, History, Profile to the left. Flat white bar, 1px top border, no gradient. Active tab: icon + label in accentFill with a small accentTint pill behind the icon; inactive: text.secondary.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Header row (RTL): greeting or screen title on the right in display style, points chip on the left (star icon + points on accentTint).
sharedComponents.gameHeader: Full-screen game header (RTL): challenge counter '۳ از ۱۵' on the right, circular countdown timer in the center showing remaining seconds of 90, running score chip on the left. Thin progress bar of 15 segments under it.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, 56px tall, accentFill with white label (pressed darker, disabled 40% opacity). Secondary button: pill, white with 1.5px borderStrong border, ink label. Text input: 12px radius, 52px, white, borderStrong border, focus = 2px accentFill ring, error = danger border + 13px helper. Card: white, 20px radius, soft shadow. Chip: pill, 32px, accentTint fill with accentFill text, 13px. Game tile: 16px radius white card with 1.5px border, holds one big flat 2D vector object (fruit, animal, shape); selected-correct = success tint + check, wrong = danger tint + x. Answer buttons are big (min 64px tall) for kids and elderly.

designSystem.frame: 393x852 mobile, top inset 59px, bottom inset 34px, right-to-left layout

type.fontNote: Picked row font Exo 2 / Saira Condensed has no Persian glyphs; Vazirmatn (Google Font, OFL) is used for the required Persian RTL script.
type.minSize: 12px (13px chips and tags, 14px safety or legal text)
type.scaleRule: Use only the 5 declared sizes (display, title, body, label, caption).

designSystem.a11y: white labels only on accentFill; text on gradients >= 4.5:1; tap targets >= 44pt (game answers >= 64px)

results.pair: accentFill as link text on background
warning text on its tint and on surface
success text on its tint and on surface
danger text on its tint and on surface
support as chart line / icon on surface (non-text 3:1)
